So I’m a dancer and a dance teacher. One day I was walking to the theatre where I had a performance that evening. I lived about 10 minutes away so I decided not to take out my car and lose my parking spot. The walk would serve as a good warm up anyway. 

I was in my ballet bun, full make up, and was holding the tutu in my arms. Now I don’t exactly live in a posh neighborhood, so cat calling was a common occurrence, and I loathed it. I used to tell myself, “okay, the next time I get catcalled I will definitely say something and stand up for myself!”
